name: eir mobile
notes: One of Ireland's three mobile network operators with its own radio network. Offers prepaid, bill pay, business mobile and bundles with broadband.

name: Vodafone Ireland
notes: One of Ireland's three mobile network operators with its own network. Offers consumer and business mobile services.

name: Three Ireland
notes: One of Ireland's three mobile network operators. Operates a nationwide mobile network.
Youth-focused low-cost mobile brand owned by Three Ireland.

name: GoMo
notes: Digital-first low-cost mobile provider owned by eir.

name: An Post Mobile
notes: Prepay-focused mobile virtual network operator operated through An Post.

name: Clear Mobile
notes: Low-cost mobile provider using Vodafone's network.

name: Lyca Mobile Ireland
notes: International MVNO specialising in low-cost domestic and international calling.

name: Sky Mobile Ireland
notes: Mobile provider from Sky Ireland offering SIM-only and handset plans.

name: Tesco Mobile Ireland
notes: Mobile virtual network operator associated with Tesco Ireland.

name: Virgin Mobile Ireland
notes: Mobile brand operated by Virgin Media Ireland using Three's network.
